title: AAC Configuration Provider Document 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Configuration Provider Document schema and its serialized data contract.

FormatVersion.description: Version of the persisted or exchanged document format.

ConfigurationScope.description: Scope within which this configuration document applies.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this configuration scope.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration scope.

ConfigurationTarget.description: Identifies the component, provider, or scope targeted by this persisted configuration.

ComponentId.description: Stable identifier of the AAC component associated with this configuration target.

ProviderInstanceId.description: Stable identifier of the provider instance associated with this configuration target.

Payload.description: Canonical payload carried by this AAC configuration provider document.

ConfigurationSchemaId.description: Stable identifier of the configuration schema associated with this payload.

ConfigurationSchemaVersion.description: Version of the configuration schema associated with this payload.

WrittenByComponentVersion.description: Component version that last wrote this persisted configuration payload.

Values.description: Configuration values stored for the target.

Policies.description: Configuration policies stored with the effective values.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this payload.

RecordRevision.description: Storage-provider record revision used for optimistic concurrency and change tracking.
